# provider-adapter-kit

> Uniform text-completion adapters for the Anthropic Messages, Gemini generateContent and OpenAI-compatible chat APIs over an injected HTTP transport, with one error model Python package `trysac-provider-adapter-kit`, import name `provider_adapter_kit`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
